title: Docker daemon permission denied errors across multiple tasks
description: The QA harness encounters consistent 'Permission denied' errors when attempting to access the Docker daemon, affecting API spec retrieval, toolkit binding, and proxied request execution.
symptoms: Docker permission error ('Permission denied') appears in logs during find-credential task
API spec retrieval fails despite agent narration claiming success
Access request approval not persisted to platform
Execution records not created despite agent CLI showing success
Test-api container logs show Permission denied errors
root_cause_hint: Docker socket or container runtime permissions not properly configured in harness; likely the broker or control-plane service lacks sufficient permissions to interact with Docker daemon or test-api container.
evidence: Logged observation: 'docker log error indicates Permission denied when fetching server API version'
Logged blocker: 'Docker permission error appears consistently across find-credential, add-to-toolkit, and make-proxied-request tasks, suggesting infrastructure/container access issue'
Verification: 'test-api container logs show Permission denied error'

title: jq command not available in agent environment
description: The agent attempted to use jq for JSON parsing but the command is not available in the harness environment.
symptoms: Exit code 127: /bin/bash: line 1: jq: command not found
Agent narration shows fallback to Python for JSON parsing
root_cause_hint: jq is not installed in the agent container or shell environment; agent had to work around this limitation.
relevant_files: Agent container Dockerfile or environment setup
evidence: Exit code 127 error in logged errors
Agent narration: 'Let me use Python to parse and display the spec:' (workaround)
